title: lava events --json
description: Every event app/Listeners.php names and the listeners it reaches, in the order they run: the registry as boot read it, so a listener that is not listed here does not run. Each listener carries the phase that placed it, and an entry's listeners are in the order an event of that entry runs them rather than the order the file lists. Registered by lavaphp/events.

file.description: app/Listeners.php when the app has one; null when it has none.

phases.description: The ordering vocabulary the pack ships, lowest rank first. A bare id in app/Listeners.php is the default phase; Phase::first() and Phase::last() name the other two. It belongs to the pack rather than to the app, so it is present even when the app did not boot.

events.description: One entry per key of app/Listeners.php, in file order. An event reaches the listeners of every entry it is an instance of, each listener once.

event.description: An event class, or an interface the events it covers implement.

listeners.description: The listeners an event of this entry runs, in that order: phase rank first, then file order within a phase. A listener this entry inherits from an interface its events implement is listed here too, so this can differ from the ids written under this key.

listener.description: The container id of the listener.

phase.description: The phase the file gave it; default when no Phase wrapped the id.
